stories.title: Opinion: From Jay Hammond to JKT, Alaska comes full circle
stories.summary: The promise of a new administration echoes an older Alaska tradition of finding common ground and planning for future generations.

stories.title: Port MacKenzie rail construction could come as soon as summer, Alaska Railroad CEO says
stories.summary: The state-owned railroad approved final plans for the spur line this week. The project is expected to cost $311 million, mostly funded by the federal government.

stories.title: Mamdani announces sweeping plan to close NYC’s notorious Rikers Island jail complex
stories.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s strategy for finally shuttering the facility hinges on substantially reducing the number of people kept behind bars.

stories.title: New University of Alaska tuition structure raises some costs and cuts others for Alaska students
stories.summary: The move follows the UA Board of Regents cutting out-of-state tuition rates earlier this year, and officials say the new tuition structure is simpler.

stories.title: A second federal judge blocks construction of Trump’s memorial arch in DC
stories.summary: Plaintiffs’ attorneys say the order will keep the construction work on hold indefinitely pending the outcome of multiple lawsuits challenging the project.

stories.title: Agriculture secretary’s ‘proselytizing’ emails are unconstitutional, judge rules
stories.summary: Emails that Brooke Rollins sent to USDA staff about Christmas and Easter also breached the department’s own rules, the judge said.

stories.title: Trump threatens penalties on U.S. companies building data centers abroad
stories.summary: Despite backing from the president, the data centers powering the artificial intelligence boom have become politically toxic.

stories.title: White House replaces top cybersecurity official after string of outages
stories.summary: The departure of Sean Cairncross continues the ouster of aides associated with former chief of staff Susie Wiles.

stories.title: Uncontacted Indigenous people emerge from Amazon forest to ask for food
stories.summary: Their appearance startled onlookers and worried anthropologists as threats to their territory multiply.

stories.title: Using AI, mathematician claims to have solved one of math’s great mysteries
stories.summary: AI may have cracked the Riemann hypothesis, one of math’s most cherished mysteries. For mathematicians, the breakthrough brings both wonder and loss.

stories.title: Stocks waver as tech sell-off continues and Anthropic falls
stories.summary: AI stocks have been losing ground partly over worries that their big market values and heavy spending are unjustified.

stories.title: Russian missiles land in Poland, as Europe held military drills nearby. NATO calls it a violation.
stories.summary: The incidents occurred while Russia carried out a major nighttime bombardment of neighboring Ukraine.
